subject: A small district durbar in a north Indian town. Under a scalloped awning hung with red and gold cloth, the landholders of the district sit in two facing rows on carpets, dressed in fine coats and turbans. At the head sits the English district officer in a white uniform, being presented with a garland by an elderly landholder while a servant holds a silver tray. Musicians with a drum and a shehnai at the lower left, a line of onlookers along the top, and the whitewashed front of the cutcherry behind. Everything laid out flat and symmetrically.
